rule: Pre-registered on 2026-11-12, before any candidate ran: this file's rule, candidates and frozen hashes were committed first. Candidates: a kit seed and a layout seed per candidate, drawn from os.urandom (63-bit), in the order listed; candidate i's kit is keyed_env.sample_kit(numpy.random.default_rng(kit_seed), id) and its layout and noise seed is layout_seed. The frozen reference solution (solution/ at frozen_commit; the sha256 of every file it and the grader run are under `frozen`) runs each candidate ONCE, in drawn order, through the grader itself (tests/review/regrade.sh: a fresh container of the task image with the verifier's resources and layout, the submission that solution/solve.sh writes, a one-episode plan). A candidate is kept when the reference completes its kit: kit_complete 1 (all three nuts assembled and still seated, none ruined), with no abort, no fault and no controller-budget cut. The hidden set (tests/ref/episodes.json) is the first 10 kept candidates in drawn order. Should fewer than 10 of the 16 be kept, 8 more candidates are drawn the same way, appended and run, and so on. Every drop is recorded with its reason; the hollowing check compares the kept kits' features (turn sizes and directions, dead ends, false entrances, mass, friction, reach, peg spacing) with all candidates'. The reference is deterministic on a candidate (it acts on the real observation's proprioception from _gt; layout and noise follow from the seeds), so the anchor's full verify of the set must repeat every kept run (kit_complete, nuts assembled, steps).
